headline: Stocks Rally and Crude Plummets on Middle East Ceasefire Hopes
teaser: Crude oil prices tumbled roughly seven percent on prospects of a Middle East ceasefire, sparking broad risk-on sentiment across major indexes. This geopolitical cooling reduces safe-haven demand, potentially pressuring the XAU/USD pair.
headline_km: ទីផ្សារភាគហ៊ុនឡើងថ្លៃស្របពេលតម្លៃប្រេងធ្លាក់ចុះចំពេលមានក្តីសង្ឃឹមឈប់បាញ់នៅមជ្ឈិមបូព៌ា
